caption:
You can't outrun the verdict. The guilt keeps its grip — but what if someone already stood in your place and took the sentence? (Galatians 3:13 devotional)

Christ redeemed you from the curse by becoming a curse for you — hanging on a tree so the sentence you owed would fall on Him. Your curse passed to Him, His righteousness to you: the great exchange. The verdict against you wasn't waived; it was paid in His own blood, so the Father can run to embrace you.
